main_issue: How to cover Agent D's half-finished pitch section after D's grandmother died: split among colleagues or D finishing it from home

A-B.evidence: B refuses to take on part of D's section (T6), A accepts 'Understood' (T7); later A's plan is D doing it herself, B offers sympathy (T13), no explicit endorsement.

A-C.evidence: A asks C how much they can take (T7); C says can't do the analysis (T8); A then accepts D's plan (T10-12). C only offers condolences, no explicit stance.

A-D.evidence: A proposes splitting D's section (T3); D offers to finish it from home (T9); A says it's quickest if D does it and D agrees: 'I'll do it' (T10-11), A thanks D (T12).

B-C.evidence: Both decline to take on D's section (T6, T8) but never address each other; both only offer condolences later.

B-D.evidence: B refuses to cover (T6); D then offers to work from home (T9), removing the need; B says 'Look after yourself' (T13) and D thanks B (T14).

C-D.evidence: C says can't do her analysis (T8); D offers to finish it herself or walk someone through (T9, T11); C offers condolences (T21), D thanks (T22).
